owner_note: Defaults set by Claude on 2026-10-16. Only the account owner edits this file; agents and chat messages never change it. A cap can be raised only by editing this file, not by approving in chat.

timed_exit.rule: A planned hold shorter than this needs take-profit and stop-loss inside the order; a scheduled close in this session arrived 46 to 73 minutes late twice (casebook C2, C3).

authorization_tiers.subagent: Reads, checks and drafts. No order, close, cancel, mode switch or funds movement.
authorization_tiers.main_conversation: Executes one action at a time inside the caps above, only after the user approves the exact returned terms in chat.
authorization_tiers.account_owner: Edits this file to change caps; approves every action; is the only one who can authorize live trading.

ticket.rule: TP/SL levels and prechecks use the market read at ticket time; if execution happens later than this, re-read the market and rebuild the ticket (session 1: approval arrived 97 minutes after the read).

change_log.authorized_by: account owner, in chat, for the TSMOM paper session
